# Experiments

This folder holds exploratory, non-production design experiments generated by AI assistants (Claude Fable 5.1 High via Chatbot Arena) as part of a research and design iteration process.

> **These files are NOT part of the production codebase.** They are reference artifacts for creative direction only — do not merge into `site/` without explicit review.

---

## Files

### `fable-redesign-v1.html`
**Date:** 2026-09-04  
**Model:** Claude Fable 5.1 High (via arena.ai)  
**What it is:** A first-pass, single-file HTML redesign of the entire Belief Changer website generated by Claude Fable 5.1 High in one shot. Includes Tailwind CDN, GSAP, Lenis smooth scroll, animated manifesto sections, and an editorial scroll-reveal layout.

### `fable-redesign-v2.html`
**Date:** 2026-09-04  
**Model:** Claude Fable 5.1 High (via arena.ai)  
**What it is:** A refined second-pass redesign. Improved scroll animation, updated section pacing, and better typographic hierarchy. All 10 book covers are referenced as flat filenames (e.g. `01-sugar.png`) — to preview locally, serve from the `Downloads/belief-changer-all-photos/` directory using `python -m http.server 8765`.

---

## How to Preview

```bash
# In the belief-changer-all-photos directory that contains the flat images:
python -m http.server 8765
# Then open: http://localhost:8765/fable-redesign-v2.html
```

Or just open the `.html` files directly in a browser (some images may not load without the server).
